title: Readers of the brain
description: Who within the household may read besides the owner: by default per hub, per note overridden by the frontmatter readers. The owner always reads; source: client is always the owner only. Checked by the lint (checkReaders); enforced by the app when fetching (readersOf), never in the prompt.

id.description: Slug; unique. The owner is not in the list

role.description: Optional, free text for the app (e.g. partner, child)

default.description: Readers of a note without a hub, or with a hub that is not in hubs. Missing: the owner only

hubs.description: Per hub (areas/<hub>.md) the default readers; an empty list is the owner only
